traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets power. Forceful, penetrating communication; words that can heal or wound and tend to be remembered. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Communication turns coercive or obsessive. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for thinking against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the thinking/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: A conversation can become obsessive when one more piece of information starts to look like the thing that will finally create control.

readerCopy.body: A conversation can become obsessive when one more piece of information starts to look like the thing that will finally create control. When Mercury squares Pluto, thought and power grind against each other, making secrets, selective language, and unanswered questions unusually difficult to leave alone. Digging deeper may uncover something important, but investigation can also become a substitute for accepting uncertainty. Enough information is the amount needed to make the next decision, not every answer another person or system could possibly withhold.
